limitations: Pinned v2.28.2 string datetime helper requires both integer and string types and always returns absent; modern InstallDate and LinkDate are not recovered by this standard entry. Legacy six-column entry preserves raw LinkDate.
Native output is a flat eleven-column table; TreeGrid parent/child indentation is not represented. Program ID association orders programs ahead of matching file groups.
Discovery uses the first matching loaded hive and shared verified Registry process space; pool-scan fallback for damaged loaded hive lists remains outstanding.

Default real cases cover Windows 10 build 15063 and Windows 11 build 22000 x64 only. Win8 volume-nested file walking and numeric/string boundaries also have synthetic coverage, not an independent Win8 real-image acceptance.
ARM64 is explicitly unsupported; x86 is not established by positive real-image cases. Other builds, arbitrary non-ASCII registry names and malformed-cell behavior need broader comparisons.
Missing data remains absent with diagnostics; native does not zero-pad lost evidence. Source type metadata and value names are exact, case-sensitive matches.
Timeliner integration and complete parameter/failure contracts remain unverified. Empty absent-hive observations do not count as positive recovery evidence.
Resource limits preserve explicit partial diagnostics. A section that fails before returning its record list cannot supply records from that failed section.
